title: Accept a core inspect historical run when no active run exists
outcome: Preserve canonical work identity without treating the legitimate latest historical run as an active run or malformed protocol when core inspect has active_run_id:null. Existing task eligibility should produce its accurate refusal or unavailable canonical-index result.
acceptance: A request-path test uses the pinned core-inspect shape with active_run_id:null and a historical run for the same work; the host does not misclassify that shape as a malformed-identity 502, and a historical run for another work still fails closed.
